_comment: The same fcc Al calculation as al_abacus.json, with H(R) read from a NextHam HR_atom_pairs.h5 instead (format 'nextham'). A NextHam prediction, post-processed (pre_post_process/post_process.py --convert-only), is exactly this file; this one was written from ABACUS's own H(R) by NextHam's writer (to_nextham.py), so its values are known and both inputs give the same results. To use a real prediction, point 'path' at your HR_atom_pairs.h5 and keep the rest -- the structure in ABACUS's atom order and the .orb files NextHam's ABACUS data was computed with.
